H3: Drought-versus-well-watered yield contrast differs among genotypes (genotype-by-regime interaction in descriptive sense), with rationale that tolerance is not uniform; evaluation criterion is heterogeneity of exploratory block-bootstrap contrasts across genotypes, falsified if contrasts are homogeneous within uncertainty.

report.conclusion: The Ghana combined source contains 864 plot records, 72 genotypes, and environment indices DROUGHT_Y1, DROUGHT_Y2, DROUGHT_Y3, WELL_WATERED_Y1, WELL_WATERED_Y2, WELL_WATERED_Y3. Observed plots by regime: DROUGHT: 432; WELL_WATERED: 432. Observed missing values by field: ear_height_value: 1 of 864; location_code: 864 of 864; plant_height_value: 1 of 864; plot: 864 of 864; stay_green_score: 432 of 864. Top descriptive drought genotype yield summaries (equal-environment mean, kg/ha): TZm-1179 2370.3; TZEE-W HDT C3 STR C5 (CHECK) 2356.7; TZm-480 2334.9. These summaries do not estimate rank confidence intervals or rank probabilities; alpha-lattice effects and multiplicity are not adjusted. These are not field recommendations. Equal-weighted observed yield means were 1230.3 kg/ha (managed drought) and 2616.0 kg/ha (well-watered); the descriptive drought-minus-control contrast was -1385.8 kg/ha (95% block-bootstrap interval -1552.2 to -1215.7). Observed drought-to-well-watered yield retention is available: 47.0%. This descriptive ratio requires a positive well-watered mean; otherwise it is null, and it is not a causal tolerance estimate. Observed drought variability was summarized across 3 environment codes; 72 genotypes had complete environment coverage. Leave-one-environment-out ranks quantify sensitivity, not validated adaptation or confidence intervals.
